activity_summary: At home you left the October page as it was. You did not count a part, and you did not start the tradesmen. Tomorrow is the reading at Holywell, not a performance.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said it, and did not go back to the table.

facets.activity: Left the October page for the morning reading

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not adding to last month's line.
